# Candidate Assessment: DOC_resume_ninety vs. DOC_posting_ten_five

## Mandatory Requirements

| # | Requirement | Résumé evidence | Match |
|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | Python | Languages: Python | ✅ |
| 2 | SQL | Languages: SQL | ✅ |
| 3 | Linux administration | Platform: Linux administration | ✅ |
| 4 | Git | Platform: Git | ✅ |
| 5 | REST API design | Services: REST API design | ✅ |
| 6 | Unit testing | Services: unit testing | ✅ |
| 7 | CI pipelines | Services: CI pipelines | ✅ |
| 8 | Docker, Kubernetes, Terraform, Ansible, Helm | Infrastructure: all five listed | ✅ |
| 9 | Kafka | Streaming: Kafka | ✅ |
| 10 | GraphQL | Not mentioned | ❌ |

## Mandatory Match Percentage

**90% (9 of 10 requirements)**

Item 8 bundles five technologies into one numbered requirement. If each technology counts separately, there are 14 mandatory skills. The candidate has 13 of them, which is **92.9%**. The result is the same either way: the score is above the 85% threshold.

## Outcome

✅ **PROCEED.** The mandatory match exceeds 85%.

## Notes

- **Only gap:** GraphQL. It may be worth asking about in the interview, since a candidate with strong REST API design experience can often pick it up quickly.
- **Nice-to-have (not part of the decision):** The résumé lists none of these (Grafana, Prometheus, technical writing, mentoring, public speaking). As you instructed, this doesn't change the outcome. The résumé is also a terse skills list, so these may simply be left out rather than missing.
